name: PDF Rotate
summary: Rotate all or selected PDF pages by 90°, 180°, or 270° — in your browser, no upload.
description: Drop a PDF, choose a clockwise rotation, apply it to every page or a page range, and download the result. Rotation stacks on any existing page rotation. Processing stays on your device.

faqs.question: Is my PDF uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Rotation runs entirely in your browser with pdf-lib.

faqs.question: Can I rotate only some pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose Selected pages and enter a range like 1-3,5.

faqs.question: What about password-protected PDFs?
faqs.answer: Encrypted PDFs aren’t supported yet and show a clear error.
